title: What CSS controls and why it exists
learningObjectives: Explain and apply what css controls and why it exists.

understand.concept: CSS controls presentation: colour, typography, spacing, layout and responsive visual behaviour. HTML provides structure and meaning; CSS describes how that structure is presented.
understand.whyItMatters: HTML works without CSS, but CSS makes content clearer, more usable and adaptable to different screens.
understand.analogy: If HTML is a building's structure, CSS is its visual finish and interior design.
understand.analogyLimit: CSS is more than colour; it affects layout, responsive behaviour, interaction states and accessibility preferences.

explain.narrative: CSS controls presentation: colour, typography, spacing, layout and responsive visual behaviour. HTML provides structure and meaning; CSS describes how that structure is presented.
